scope: Read-only independent R2 semantic review of the frozen preview candidate and successor SOURCE-SEMANTICS contract. No production source edits, Git mutation, Vault mutation, external runtime, or Builder dispatch.

api_shape.contracts.py: Registry handoff only: expose exact new schema titles/resources; keep all v1 validators and identity functions byte-compatible.
markdown_locator_v2.py: validate_markdown_locator_v2(locator, *, association, payload, observation) -> normalized locator
source_semantics.py: derive_display_head(*, paper_id, associations, decisions) -> str | None

blockers.detail: Exact field names, IDs, limits, resource filenames, registry handoff and allowed implementation paths are not frozen by SOURCE-CANONICAL-DESIGN-R1.
Freeze the prior receipt path/hash plus the precise claimed-input/source-ledger-write checks; association must never self-reference its future receipt.
Choose immutable variant schema/namespace versus explicit PROVENANCE_VARIANT refusal and define whether variants can be reused.
Freeze engine-owned decision/head paths and transaction successor semantics; current v1 publication/catalog do not own this registry.
Freeze v2 profile names, migration event fields, prior v1 snapshot binding and one-authoritative-chain derivation.
Freeze complete prospective inventory shape and exact legacy/v2 page byte-compatibility rules before implementation; current compiler accepts only compile-input.v1 and paper-record.v1.
Existing canonical paper identity priority can reject SHA→arXiv alias promotion; add a separate immutable alias binding and keep identity.py v1 behavior unchanged.

source_semantics_contract.purpose: Pure validation, identity, migration, display-head derivation, and prospective compiler material. No Vault or operator mutation.
required_tests: preserve all v1 IDs, event bytes, fingerprints and compiler output bytes
unknown/declared versions; same-byte multi-version reuse; explicit-version byte conflict
first-association refusal without prior audited source-registration receipt; receipt path/hash/content mismatch
provenance variant retention/refusal and no observation overwrite
Markdown Unicode UTF-8 byte spans, page-anchor/hash mismatch, v1 wire refusal
v1→v2 profile migration bound to prior head/claim snapshot and provisional reset
mixed prospective compiler inventory, legacy byte stability, provisional core eligibility, deterministic escaping and path collisions

assessment-claim.v2 and assessment-event.claim: Preserve claim_id formula and text; add explicit evidence_profile (legacy-v1, markdown-v2, mixed-v2), v2 evidence list, current assessment and reviewed_at.
assessment-claim.v2 and assessment-event.event: Preserve append-only fields and add evidence_profile/profile_transition metadata. profile_migration is a system transition from legacy-v1 to v2, points to prior immutable v1 head and claim snapshot hash, and targets provisional; it is not a second genesis.
assessment-claim.v2 and assessment-event.fingerprint: Domain-separated JCS over required v2 locator identities in canonical order; legacy v1 fingerprint remains byte-identical. Any evidence/profile switch requires system invalidation or migration before human review.

markdown-locator.v2.rule: Half-open UTF-8 byte span into exact decoded Markdown bytes; nonempty/in-range; hash and optional page anchor must match observation. Association/version is part of evidence identity. vpwiki-locator-v2 wire is closed and rejected by v1 decoder.

paper-record.v2/compiler-input.v2.inventory: Prospective compiler consumes complete source ledger, associations/provenance variants, paper records, display decisions/heads, claims, assessment events/heads and code material. Partial v2 namespaces or unknown managed entries refuse.
paper-record.v2/compiler-input.v2.output: Legacy v1 pages remain byte-identical when related inputs are unchanged. V2 pages expose imported versions, selection state, exact evidence references and assessment status; provisional pages explicitly state no accepted core conclusion. Sort all identities deterministically and escape hostile source/model text in frontmatter, links and body.
paper-record.v2/compiler-input.v2.record: Preserve v1 identity/title/authors/taxonomy/section refs; add complete sorted association refs, derived display_head_ref, selected_association_id, and retain active_extraction_path/hash as a mirror that must equal the selected association.

source-display-decision.v1 and source-di.actor_record: Externally supplied exact choice record with event_id/text/source/recorded_at; no model prose authority.
source-display-decision.v1 and source-di.decision: {schema, decision_id, paper_id, previous_decision_id|null, association_id, choice: select|clear, actor_record, reason}
source-display-decision.v1 and source-di.head: Derived only from one complete append-only nonforking chain; head stores paper_id, terminal decision_id and selected association_id|null.
source-display-decision.v1 and source-di.rules: Exactly one genesis, no missing predecessor/fork/cycle, imports never auto-select, rollback is a new decision, head and paper mirror are transaction outputs in later publication.

source-version-association.v1.content: {raw_path, sha256, size_bytes}; raw_path must be exact .raw/captured/<sha>.md and match source_id/bytes.
source-version-association.v1.extraction: {profile, artifact_path, artifact_sha256, source_observation_sha256}; exact source-derived artifact binding.
source-version-association.v1.identity_rule: association_id/content identity is separate from same-version conflict key; unknown keys include Markdown digest; same explicit version+same bytes reuses, different bytes conflicts; metadata never overwrites bytes.
source-version-association.v1.observation: Exact frozen markdown-source-observation.v1 object plus observation_sha256; no normalization or synthetic receipt.
source-version-association.v1.registration_receipt: {path, sha256, sequence, operation_id}; prior audited receipt whose claimed_inputs contains raw_path+sha256 and whose source-ledger write binds the association.
source-version-association.v1.version: {kind: unknown, label: null} or {kind: declared, label: nonempty bounded string}; observed/official labels require a later explicit acquisition binding.

source-version-provenance.v1.rule: Same Markdown/version bytes with changed original PDF or observation metadata is an immutable provenance variant or explicit PROVENANCE_VARIANT refusal; it never silently replaces the association.
